nodes.name: Weekly Mon 08:00
nodes.notes: ADR-054 Block 6: weekly onboarding-coverage dead-man's-switch. The per-session degrade WARN (Block 2/3a) only fires when an un-onboarded user actually triggers the agent; this proactively catches an ACTIVE, FULL ClickUp member who is missing EITHER per-user ClickUp token, so nobody is silently left un-scoped. Weekly (Mon 08:00 Europe/Warsaw) on purpose - a coverage nag must not spam.

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test entry for Definition-of-Done verification via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs (a Schedule Trigger cannot be fired over the n8n API). No inputs needed.

nodes.name: Get Team
nodes.notes: GET /api/v2/team on the BOT token (clickUpApi cred QRrgf6hteyGWSJyv) -> teams[].members[].user with role_key + last_active. This is the only place last_active is available (the trimmed MCP member view omits it). A failure throws -> the global Error Handler raises CRITICAL (we lose coverage visibility, not the pipeline).

nodes.name: Get Onboarding State
nodes.notes: get_clickup_onboarding_state() (migration 044, SECURITY DEFINER, service_role only) -> {mcp_ids:[...], rest_ids:[...]} - which ClickUp user ids have an active MCP discovery credential and which have a REST extraction token. Returns ids ONLY, never token values, so it is safe to surface in the alert.

nodes.name: Compute Coverage
nodes.notes: WARN rule (ADR-054 Block 6, operator-set): a member is flagged when ALL hold - (1) full member (role_key owner/admin/member; guest + limited_member excluded), (2) active in the last 30 days (last_active), (3) missing EITHER token (MCP discovery and/or REST extraction). Someone with BOTH tokens is clear. The Agent Haxe bot account (99811284) is hard-excluded - it is the agent, never an onboardee, and its last_active is bumped by our own API calls.

nodes.name: Any Missing?
nodes.notes: count>0 -> WARN via Post Alert; count==0 -> Healthy (silent; a clean coverage run must NOT post to the Alerts task every week).

nodes.name: Healthy
nodes.notes: Terminal for full coverage. Silent on purpose.

nodes.name: Alert Coverage Gap
nodes.notes: WARN via Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025). Lists each active full member missing a token and which token. Action: run the onboarding script(s) named in details. Not CRITICAL - the run still degrades safely per user (Block 2/3a); this is a reminder, not an outage.
